summary: Verified all 9 homepage enhancement requirements. Animated entrance: 4 .hero-opening-item elements all opacity=1 after ~2s (eyebrow, headline 'FIND YOUR PLACE IN LONDON.', subheadline, search form). Hero search overlay: all 5 fields visible with data-testids (location/type/min/max/submit). Intent options exactly ['Buy','Rent','Invest']. Submitting location=Chelsea + Invest + min=1000000 navigated to /properties?location=Chelsea&intent=Invest&min=1000000 and the location filter on /properties was pre-filled to 'Chelsea'. Scroll journey preserved: at 5% opening op=1, layer-london scale(1.06); at 20% opening faded to 0 and hero-layer-west opacity=1 (crossfade started, london scaled up to 1.22); hero-final opacity=1 at 71%/97%. CTAs: hero-explore-cta=/properties, hero-journey-cta=/calculators/mortgage. Nav underline: all 5 nav links (nav-properties/investment/mortgages/areas/about) have class nav-underline; hovering nav-properties turned color gold rgb(212,175,55) and ::after transform showed scaleX~0.99 with gold bg rgb(212,175,55). Scroll cue: hero-scroll-hint visible with 'SCROLL TO EXPLORE' + gold arrow, .foxy-bounce element present with animation-name=foxy-bounce. Featured Properties: [data-testid=featured-properties] renders 3 cards (chelsea/kensington/fulham prototypes) each with image, area, title, £ price, 'X Bed'/'Y Bath', 'PROTOTYPE · NOT A LIVE PROPERTY' label, and gold VIEW PROPERTY button linking to /properties/<slug>. Clicking VIEW PROPERTY on chelsea navigated correctly. prefers-reduced-motion: section height=100vh, hero-opening op=1 + search visible, london layer op=1 west op=0, hint hidden, foxy-bounce animation disabled — static & usable. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (docW=vw=390), opening + search visible, featured cards stack vertically. Zero uncaught console errors during load + full scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertySearch.tsx is a single-line minified component (line 9 is a huge JSX blob) — hurts readability/maintainability; consider reformatting.
Featured card images are external Unsplash URLs; if Unsplash is unreachable the cards degrade to alt text. Consider self-hosting under /public for reliability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js app served at http://localhost:3000. Hero desktop height 720vh (~9280px scroll). Drive scroll with window.scrollTo * scrollHeight with ~900ms dwell. Note hero-layer-london keeps opacity=1 throughout (i===0 special case in render()); other layers crossfade on top starting after 10% hold. hero-search 'intent' (Buy/Rent/Invest) is separate from /properties building-type filter — only 'location' hands off. GSAP entrance uses gsap.from stagger 0.12 delay 0.15 — allow ~2s before asserting opening opacity.
